raw_segments.text: Leance, thou want'st ye a rough pash and the shoots that I have to be full like me.
Yet they say we are almost as like as eggs, women say so, that will say anything.
But were they false as or dyed blacks, as wind, as waters, false as dice are to be wished
by one that fixes no born, twixt his and mine, yet were it true to say this boy were like
Come, Sir Page, look on me with your welcome eye, sweet villain, most dearestie, my collab,
can thy dam, mate be, affection.
Thy intention stabs the centre, thou dost make possible things not so held, communicat'st
with dreams, how can this be?
With what's unreal thou coactive art and fellow'st ye nothing, then tis very credent thou mayst
ye cojoin with something, and thou dost, and that beyond commission, and I find it, and
that to the infection of my brains and hardening of my brows.
